statBlock.name: Fire Giant
statBlock.description: Fire giants build foundries and fortresses around sources of intense heat. They prize smithcraft and train children for war.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatsword attacks.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 28 (6d6 + 7) slashing damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

statBlock.name: Frost Giant
statBlock.description: Frost giants hunt and raid from high peaks and glacial strongholds. Their standing depends on feats of strength and trophies won in battle.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greataxe attacks.
Greataxe. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 25 (3d12 + 6) slashing damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

statBlock.name: Storm Giant
statBlock.description: Storm giants live in secluded places, including underwater palaces. They watch the sea and sky for omens.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The giant breathes air and water.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma, spell save DC 17. The giant casts these spells without material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Feather Fall, Levitate, Light.
3/day each. Control Weather, Water Breathing.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatsword attacks.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 30 (6d6 + 9) slashing damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +14 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 35 (4d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage.
Lightning Strike (recharge 5–6). Choose a point the giant can see within 500 ft. and strike it with magical lightning. Every creature within 10 ft. of that point makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. It takes 54 (12d8) lightning damage on a failure or half that on a success.

statBlock.name: Cyclops
statBlock.description: A cyclops often lives alone or with a small family, tending a herd and driving strangers away from its territory.

sections.Traits: Poor Depth Perception. The cyclops rolls attacks with disadvantage against targets more than 30 ft. away.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatclub attacks.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

statBlock.name: Ettin
statBlock.description: An ettin has two independent minds and one body. Its heads bicker constantly but can work together when threatened.

sections.Traits:
Two Heads. The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saves against being Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, or knocked Unconscious.
Wakeful. If either head sleeps, the other stays awake.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Battleaxe attack and one Morningstar attack.
Battleaxe. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.
Morningstar. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Ogre
statBlock.description: Ogres wander the edges of settlements, raiding isolated farms for food. They fill their sacks with whatever catches their eye.

sections.Actions:
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Oni
statBlock.description: An oni infiltrates settlements in a borrowed guise. It may serve a hag or wizard in return for a safe lair or a magic item.

sections.Traits:
Magic Weapons. The oni makes magical weapon attacks.
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the oni regains 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma, spell save DC 13. The oni casts these spells without material components.
At will. Darkness, Invisibility.
1/day each. Charm Person, Cone of Cold, Gaseous Form, Sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with its claws or glaive.
Claw (oni form only). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Glaive. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) in Small or Medium form.
Change Shape. The oni magically takes the form of a Small or Medium humanoid or a Large giant, or returns to its true form. Its statistics stay the same except for size. Its glaive is the only gear that changes, shrinking in humanoid form so the oni can wield it. When the oni dies, it returns to its true form and the glaive returns to its normal size.
